description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to amend the schedule to the order published on Gaz. Ex. No. 916/7 of 27.03.1996 which specifies the Faculty & Departments of the South Eastern University of Sri Lanka by adding the item "Faculty of Technology"
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under statutory authority (Section 27(1)) that modifies the organizational structure of a university by adding a new Faculty of Technology and its departments. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending existing regulations rather than detailing the minister's portfolio responsibilities or making personnel appointments.
